description: I am the daughter of a legal immigrant. My mother came to America from South Korea, married my father, and built a life in this country the right way. She worked hard, paid her taxes, raised her children to love America, and never asked for a single thing she had not earned. Her story is the story of millions of immigrants who came here legally and built this country alongside their American neighbors.
